subject: Alternate payment path for pilot — Bridgestone Dedicated onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Judy Lee <judy.lee@bridgestone.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Alternate payment path for pilot — Bridgestone Dedicated onboarding

Hi Judy,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to get Bridgestone set up for the Dedicated pilot. Procurement asked whether we can get a Purchase Order in place; your team mentioned that small pilots sometimes go through an "invoice-only" path to avoid PO delays.

To move quickly, we can support either route. Option A: standard PO + SOW and we run onboarding. Option B: one-off invoice-only for pilot spend under $25k, with a temporary vendor setup and a short exception form signed internally.

I've attached the draft SOW for the pilot and a blank procurement exception form for your review. Can you confirm which path your team prefers and what vendor docs you need from us (W9, vendor questionnaire, remit-to)? If invoice-only is acceptable, what internal approval should we expect on your side and who is the billing contact?

Proposed next steps:
- If PO: share PO template + billing contact.
- If invoice-only: Bridgestone confirms cap and we exchange vendor paperwork; Redwood submits invoice after milestone sign-off.

Attachments: pilot-sow-bridgestone-v1.pdf; procurement-exception-form.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: pilot-sow-bridgestone-v1.pdf]
[Attachment: procurement-exception-form.pdf]

From: Judy Lee <judy.lee@bridgestone.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bridgestone Procurement <procurement@bridgestone.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Alternate payment path for pilot — Bridgestone Dedicated onboarding

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear options. Our standard policy is to have a PO for any vendor engagement, however for proof-of-concept pilots under $25k we can accept an invoice-only approach if the following are completed first:

1) Vendor risk questionnaire (info security + data handling)
2) W9 and banking remit details
3) Internal finance approval from our Cost Controls team (I can route once we have the paperwork)

I attached our vendor setup guidelines and the onboarding form procurement needs us to return. If you can return both the questionnaire and W9 today, I will try to get Cost Controls to prioritize the approval.

Also: please confirm the exact dollar cap you want for the pilot and whether Redwood will accept an auto-generated PO if we convert to a longer-term contract.

Thanks,
Judy Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager — Bridgestone Energy
judy.lee@bridgestone.com
[Attachment: bridgestone-vendor-setup-guidelines.pdf]

Judy —

Thanks, that process sounds workable. Bridgestone's ask for a low-friction pilot aligns with our goals. Proposal from Redwood:

- Cap pilot at $20,000 (USD)
- Redwood provides completed vendor questionnaire, W9, and bank remit details by EOD PDT
- Bridgestone provides Cost Controls approval in writing (email) and a confirmation that an auto-generated PO will be created should the pilot convert to a committed contract
- If the pilot converts, Redwood will accept Bridgestone's PO and we will exchange an updated SOW/contract with standard terms

Laura, requesting conditional approval for this exception (capped, vendor docs provided, finance sign-off). Rishi — can you confirm whether Finance needs any additional safeguards (net-terms, holdback, or prepayment) on our side for a $20k invoice-only pilot?

Priyom — once approved, can you take point on completing the vendor questionnaire and W9? I'll forward Judy the signed procurement-exception-form for internal tracking.

Thanks all,
Marissa

[Quoted message from Judy Lee included above]
[Attachment: procurement-exception-form.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alternate payment path for pilot — Bridgestone Dedicated onboarding

Marissa —

I approve a conditional, time-limited invoice-only exception for the Bridgestone pilot with these firm guardrails: 

- Pilot cap: $20,000 (total invoiced amount)
- Vendor documentation must be returned (questionnaire + W9) and saved in the Bridge folder
- Bridgestone must provide explicit Cost Controls approval by email before we deliver any billable work beyond initial discovery
- If pilot converts, a formal PO from Bridgestone must be provided and Redwood will accept the PO as part of conversion

Operational steps (owners):
- Priyom: complete and submit the vendor questionnaire and W9 to Judy; attach confirmation to this thread when done.
- Marissa: send the signed procurement-exception-form to Judy and link the Confluence PO Exception Request (internal) for records.
- Rishi/Finance: flag any credit risk. Rishi, if Finance requires prepayment for this account, please note now so Sales can communicate.

I'll also draft a brief PO-exception request PDF for records — see attached; please upload to the Confluence page linked in my note. Keep the pilot scope tight to ensure we don't exceed the cap.

Laura Bennett
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment: po-exception-request-20270901.pdf]
